title: Progress of Chongqing Connectivity Initiative Project
what_it_is: Progress of Chongqing Connectivity Initiative Project

sections.label: China-Singapore Chongqing Connectivity Initiative
sections.summary: The CCI, launched in November 2015, enhances connectivity between western China and Southeast Asia through finance, aviation, transport, logistics and ICT.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The China-Singapore (Chongqing) Demonstrative Initiative on Strategic Connectivity (CCI) is a long-term Government-to-Government (G-to-G) effort that serves as a key priority demonstration project associated with China's Belt and Road Initiative.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Launched in November 2015, it has made good progress in catalysing the economic development of western China and Southeast Asia by enhancing connectivity in the areas of financial services, aviation, transport and logistics and information and communications technology (ICT).

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Under the CCI Financial Services Pillar, cross-border financing deals totalling RMB 25.3 billion, or around S$5.2 billion, have been completed to date, providing Chongqing corporates with more financing options and raising their international profile.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Aviation connectivity has also grown significantly, from five flights to 14 flights per week between Singapore and Chongqing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: The corridor aims to link Chongqing to Qinzhou or Beibu Gulf, Guangxi, in the south by rail and from Qinzhou to Singapore and beyond by sea, thereby enhancing multi-modal connectivity between western China, Southeast Asia and to the rest of the world.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: For example, the CCI-STC will significantly reduce the amount of time needed to transport goods between Chongqing and Singapore to about a week.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: Since December 2017, three block train services have been commissioned between Chongqing and Guangxi per week.

sections.label: SCCCI Chongqing representative office
sections.summary: SCCCI has recently set up a representative office in Chongqing to serve Singapore businesses there.

sentences.speaker: The Minister, Prime Minister's Office (Mr Chan Chun Sing) (for the Prime Minister)
sentences.text: SCCCI has recently set up a representative office in Chongqing to serve Singapore businesses in Chongqing.
